system.biography: Civilian vehicles, usable and maintainable by laymen. The ease of use and mobility they offer fundamentally changes humanity’s relationship with distance. Often require infrastructure like roads or tracks to function, they are more reliant on civilization than heartier vehicles.
Construction vehicles of all types; used for changing the face of a landscape and building human-habitable structures.

system.cataclysms: Earthquakes, falling debris, collapsing buildings. Plumes of concrete smoke, waves of terror and despair. Earth roiling like waves, fissures and chasms ripping the ground apart.

system.biography: Instruments of destruction, these mighty war machines sang the thunderous chorus of the end times from the barrels of their cannons. Any civilization possessing such mighty vehicles can easily impose its will on neighbors. They are highly prized and often found in the hands of ruthless warlords.

Planes and other flight vehicles. Battle the tyranny of gravity by allowing mankind access to the ancient dream of flight. Often require significant runways or landing spaces, typically require intense technical knowledge and special maintenance, and demand high skill and effort to pilot. Regardless of these drawbacks, it remains one of the most versatile and useful vehicle types.

system.description: The trademark claw of the crane, used for moving impossibly huge loads skyward. Allows the operator a Rank 8 Power action to lift anything hooked. It has enough reach to grab anything in the same or adjacent Areas within a Field. Due to it’s clumsiness and slowness, any attempts to grab with this arm require an attack and grant the foe Advantage for purposes of defending.
A heavy steel ball at the end of a long steel cable; if swung at a target (requires an attack if they’re not stationary) then it impacts for a ludicrous Rank 10 hit.

Rank 10 Attack, can be used to Grab and throw objects of size 7 or smaller with a single hand, or up to size 9 with both hands. If both hands smash together, hits an Area at Rank 12 and sends a Rank 6 Shockwave Hazard rippling through that Field.

Vulnerability: Characters are small and slippery enough to wriggling from between the mammoth fingers if they’re grabbed. They can escape with a Rank 4 Agility action.

ONCE PER LIFETIME NOT RAMPAGE

Unhinging its jaw, the Havok King breathes a beam of unearthly fire onto any Field within the same Tract as a Rank 14 blast. Once unleashed, the corrosive energies begin to melt the Havok King from the inside; it loses (1d10 time ten) Health every Round as it rapidly erodes; it collapses upon itself as a Rank 12 Hazard, trapping and melting anyone still inside or under it when it falls.

One of the Havoc King’s footsteps, smashes an Area underfoot at Rank 8 and sends a Rank 4 Tremor Hazard through the Field, damaging structures and sending earthbound characters sprawling.

If both feet land successfully, he can move up to 1 adjacent Field.

Vulnerability: If the Havoc King steps on something that his foot cannot destroy, it injures him by the difference (as the Counterattack keyword) and he falls backward, causing a Rank 10, Area-destroying disaster where his center mass lands.
Ranged attack, Rank 10 attack and a Rank 5 Shockwave that damages anything in the same Field as the impact site.
Ranged, Rank 4 area attack that sprays bullets across a Field.
Ranged, Rank 6 area attack that sprays bullets across a Field.
Ranged, Rank 9 attack that explodes and causes a Rank 4 Napalm Hazard across the Field it hits.

The massive front blade of a bulldozer can be used by the pilot to apply up to the vehicle’s Towing Capacity as a Power action for lifting, hauling, and otherwise applying force in creative ways. It also functions to give the vehicle Armor 7 from the front arc. Finally, when ramming, the vehicle deals +1 Rank of damage.
The rear claw attachment, usable by the operator to commit acts of destruction or shaping up to the Towing Capacity in Power.
Highly explosive when destroyed. Explodes at Rank 10, engulfing the Field in a fireball.
Allows otherwise blind underwater combat to be conducted as though targets could be “seen” in murky, shadowy light (Senses 2).
Rank 12 single-target strike, only aquatic targets, travel at speed 3 to hit distant targets, up to 3 Fields away.
Rank 6 Senses to see anything targetable by the Indrastra.
Rank 12 attack that strikes any Field one the side of the planet currently occupied by the station.
When ramming or running over something/someone, the front roller can catch and crush anything in the steam roller’s path with 20 tons of weight behind it (Crush at Rank 9).
top speed/handling = 1 field/action
The Havok King is an artificial Titan. While operative, the pilot has direct control of its Titan Attributes (see creature sheet)
Ranged and able to strike any visible Field within the same Tract. Strikes a Structure or Area at Rank 12 with the remaining Field suffering a Rank 8 shockwave.
